text: Rose Elliot, a poet alone in New York, reads [an alchemist's book called The Three Mothers|images|books, letters and writing] and comes to believe her building is [home to the Mother of Darkness|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. Searching the cellar, she drops her keys into a flooded ballroom where a putrid corpse rises from the water. She writes to her brother Mark in Rome, and by the time he reaches the building [Rose has vanished|trigger|someone goes missing], leaving a trail of blood on the carpet and [a swarm of cats in the dark|images|animals and birds].
